description: End-to-end verdict fixtures for combined-eval.mjs: text scoring + page signal + image fusion. imageScore values are on the classifier's calibrated scale (models/image-model.json; ml-bridge.js bars 40 / 41 / 65 / 76 / 80), so they keep their meaning across image models. Measured posters were re-recorded on 2026-10-05 for tinyclip40m-fp16-head-v1 from the bake-off's in-browser WASM embeddings (eval/bakeoff/.cache/emb-browser, crop view) x the shipped head x the calibration, by images.json id: Hereditary wp-Q47524071 76.7, The Nun wp-Q29841731 82.8, Insidious wp-Q122713 80.1, The Devil Wears Prada wp-Q223316 66.5, Mortal Kombat (1995) wp-Q819196 48.4, White House Down wp-Q2350772 18.9. Hereditary, The Nun, The Devil Wears Prada and White House Down are in the head's training split. Cape Fear is not in the bake-off image set, so 72 is now a synthetic dark-safe point. Every other score is a synthetic stress point. page references the pages map; mediaSite mirrors isMediaSiteCached(). gate entries exit nonzero on mismatch. sensitivity defaults to medium.
